A '''computer interface visor''' was a device, which when worn across the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and connected to a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system, provided the wearer with a [[Heads-up display/Legends|heads-up display]] that displayed relevant data laid over one's normal vision by translating complex computer algorithms into easy-to-understand symbols and words.
